# Manuscript — excerpt

**Methods:** We conducted a cross-sectional online survey between April and September 2024.

Comparisons between categorical variables used the Fisher exact test, and visual analog scale values were compared by the Mann-Whitney test. Comparisons by age group (35 years or younger versus older than 35 years) were exploratory and were not prespecified.

Of 56 consenting records, 53 completed the sociodemographic module and 35 entered the drug module.
